title: spOT-NMF: gene expression deconvolution via optimal transport with proximity-aware niche mapping for spatial transcriptomics.
snippet: Spatial transcriptomics enables direct profiling of cellular organization within intact tissues, yet two challenges limit its full exploitation: accurate reference-free deconvolution of mixed expression signals (including species-admixed models such as xenografts), and lack of tools that can translate per-spot program usage values into spatial niches.
